RWFTOOLS.Macro.Name: Request a test
RWFTOOLS.Request.Title: Request a test
RWFTOOLS.Request.NoPlayers: No connected player has an RWF player character.
RWFTOOLS.Request.ClearHint: Removes finished tests and cancels the ones still waiting
RWFTOOLS.Prompt.Title: Test requested by the GM
RWFTOOLS.Prompt.Invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
RWFTOOLS.Error.NoRuleset: No Rule Them'All Ruleset is active.
RWFTOOLS.Error.NotRwf: The active Ruleset has no "Test demandé par le MJ" Action: import and activate RWF 2.1.0 or later.
RWFTOOLS.Error.GMOnly: Only the GM requests a test.
RWFTOOLS.Error.NotRwfHud: The active Ruleset lacks the RWF 2.5.0 rules (combat, pursuit, exhaustion): import and activate RWF 2.5.0 or later.
RWFTOOLS.Error.HudFailed: The HUD could not read the combat (see the console).
RWFTOOLS.Hud.DamageInvalid: Enter a positive whole number for the damage.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.Title: Combat HUD
RWFTOOLS.Combat.NotInCombat: You have no combatant in this combat.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.NotRwfActor: This combatant is not on the active RWF Ruleset version.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.Contact: Target {distance} m away: you must be in contact.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.OutOfRange: Target {distance} m away, out of range ({range} m).
RWFTOOLS.Combat.WaitTurn: Not this combatant's turn: its actions wait for its turn.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.NoTargets: No other combatant on the scene.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.Title: Pursuit HUD
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.StartHint: Prepare the pursuit: the selected (or targeted) tokens take part, otherwise every token of the scene.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.CapHint: 0: no limit. Faster speeds are brought down to this value.
RWFTOOLS.Hud.Hit: Hit ({d20} on the d20): roll the dice on the table and enter their total.
RWFTOOLS.Hud.Critical: Critical: the total will be doubled automatically.
RWFTOOLS.Combat.InPursuit: A pursuit is running: open the Pursuit HUD.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.Preparing: The GM is preparing a pursuit.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.FleeBonus: The fleeing side gets +{n} initiative in the first round.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.BothSides: At least one fleeing participant and one pursuer are needed.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.NotOnScene: their token is not on the pursuit's scene; they do not take part.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.SetupHint: Split the participants between the two sides, choose who chases whom and how they move, then start the pursuit.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.NoTokens: No token of the scene plays with the RWF Ruleset.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MoveHelp.continuer: Keep the pace: a test with no bonus or malus.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MoveHelp.risque: Take a risk: a test with a malus.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MoveHelp.raccourci: Take a shortcut: a test with a bonus.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MoveHelp.stop: Stop: no test, you lose 1 (your gap shrinks, or your target's grows).
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.Status.Exhausted: out of breath, out of the race
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MovesHintFlee: Choose a move: a test at DD {dd}. Your gap grows by 1 on a success, 2 on a critical, and shrinks by 1 on a failure, 2 on a complication, plus the speed advantage ({n}). Then the turn passes.
RWFTOOLS.Pursuit.MovesHintChase: Choose a move: a test at DD {dd}. {name}'s gap shrinks by 1 on a success, 2 on a critical, and grows by 1 on a failure, 2 on a complication, plus the speed advantage ({n}). Then the turn passes.
